_source: Built from the facts of CBP ruling N354175 (2025-10-16, dev split; picked: no China-held ruling; second earliest dev): CBP held Taiwan. Product drafted by gemini-4-argon from the facts, reviewed by hand. The draft stopped at the facts' first 7,000 characters; the Chinese lamination and assembly steps were added by hand from the rest of the facts. Target China (reverse probe: away from a non-China origin); plant capabilities for China are an assumption. No later ruling on a changed setup, so there is no backtest.

product.name: Ultra Light Emitting Diode Automotive Display (uLED Display Set), model # CN30UYX02.0
product.description: An automotive display that utilizes microscopic LEDs on a thin-film transistor (TFT) glass substrate panel to project the car logo, charging status, and driving modes.

operations.name: Step 1A: Unpack and clean glass substrates and perform physical vapor deposition (PVD) and chemical vapor deposition (CVD) of metal and chemical films
Step 1A: Perform photolithography, dry/wet etching, photoresist stripping, array testing, and packing of glass substrates
Step 1B: Unpack and clean glass substrates, perform CVD and PVD thin film deposition, and repeat photolithography, etching, and stripping five times to create TFT array
Step 1B: Perform array testing, Automated Optical Inspection (AOI), robot transfer, and cutting and grinding of combined substrate into desired dimensions
Step 1C: Perform Electroless Nickel Immersion Gold (ENIG) metal plating process including cleaning, micro etching, acid rinse, nickel plating, and gold plating to output array glass substrate panel
Step 1D: Delaminate protective film, clean with FLUX cleaner, test array, and fix LEDs on template glass
Step 1D: Plasma etch template glass, FLUX coat TFT panel, apply sealant, and bond uLED cells to TFT panel in a vacuum environment before removing template glass
Step 1D: Illuminate uLEDs for optical inspection and repair, and apply, cure, bake, and etch protective and molding films
laminate the cover glass to the semi-panel and degas
assemble the uLED panel with the bezel, PCB and bracket; test and pack
